_about: QUESTS 10/19, row [the telling bank] WHERE-THIRTY-TELLINGS-A-GAME-COME-FROM, research only (rule 35; rule 88: a page is the ship). The shape of a TELLING GENERATOR for PEOPLE and twenty example tellings written on it. A telling is the night camp's no-choice scene: one face, three lines (a story with a person in it; the thing and the place; what they want you to know), one [SLEEP] button, writes nothing but its own once-key (QR-AV rules 4 and 10, QR-AX section 5). The page that argues every field and number: questbook/research/QR_AY_THE_TELLING_BANK_10_19_26.md. draft:true, tuned:false, NOTHING LIVE READS THIS FILE. Every number a player would feel is TUNING's (rule 38g); the data shape is MODS'; the lines are attempts, WORDS' and Paolo's to change.
never_before: nothing here fires in the first minute (rule 32a) or before an act's 10th night (QR-AX rule 5)
never on a CAUSED night or the two nights after it (QR-AX rule 11)

generator._about: The order the generator fills a telling. Each step only narrows. Identity first, then the facts, then the words (Q048.W5).

fields.ground: tonight's camp block: its kind from engine/BOHEMIA_REGION_LAND.json legend (open_desert, hills, wash_and_shore, freeway, suburb_block, industrial, airport, solar_and_pumps, landfill, golf_and_park, trailer_park, lot_and_bigbox, valley) and the nearest named place within 2 blocks from its places list (34, each with a 'what' line), or none. EXISTS.
fields.teller: a living member: name, background id, level (engine/bohemia_roster.js manOf). EXISTS.
fields.nights_in_company: nights since the teller joined. OWED (the roster carries xp and level, no join night).
fields.band: green (level 3 or lower), seasoned (4 to 8), veteran (9 and up), from the level. EXISTS (level).
fields.before: the person before the dollar died, assembled from the trade's four fragment groups (who, person, place before, the moment). OWED: 7 of 77 trades carry one PAIN line in engine/bohemia_roster.js; 70 fall back to 'Does not talk about before. You do not ask.'
fields.thing: an item on the body (gear main, off, body, head) read by its own name ('was': Straw Hat, Butcher's Apron), never by the roster's display name ('a rag hood', 'a work jacket'); or a veteran's thing (QR-AU rule 2); or a mark (a permanent injury). EXISTS as ids; the specific look is ASSET NEEDED per telling.
fields.company: the company's own record: the first fight's place, the dead (name, how, the night), fights together. PARTLY OWED (the deed ledger exists for the feed; the dead and the first fight as fields are not named).
fields.foil: optional: one living member at the fire named in line 1 or 2, never a second face. EXISTS (roster).
fields.told: the once-keys spent in this save: '<member>:<band>' and 'retold:<dead member>'. OWED (one list of strings in the save).

order: 1 GROUND: read tonight's block and the nearest named place.

2 TELLER: eligible = alive, at least the 10th night in the company, has not been the face of any screen in 30 nights, his band's key unspent. Score: +2 if his trade matches the ground (the miner on the quarry, the hunter at the refuge), +1 if he carries a thing with its own name, +1 if a foil whose trade pairs with his is at the fire; ties go to the longest since his last screen.

3 SOURCE by band: green = WONDER (a ground or a first he has never had); seasoned = BEFORE (the person before the dollar died); veteran = LIFE (once-ever, ties the before to the company); retold = a dead member's own telling, by a living member who rode with him 30 nights.
4 LINE 1, THE STORY: a past moment with a person in it, named by name or by role (mi papa, my foreman Ramon). Orientation and the complicating action only.
5 LINE 2, THE THING AND THE PLACE: the witness. The thing on the body and the ground tonight tie the story to now.
6 LINE 3, WHAT THEY WANT YOU TO KNOW: the point. Never a job, never a price, never an ask, never a place to go.
7 THE WRONG DETAIL: roll it (see wrong_detail).
8 THE VOICE: the member's own Spanglish and trade words (THEY SPEAK SPANGLISH); the player never speaks; three lines, each under 20 words.
9 SPEND the once-key. Write nothing else.

bands.green: level 3 or lower; the WONDER expires as he levels (Battle Brothers: 13 of its 104 background events gate on 'level N or lower').
bands.seasoned: level 4 to 8; BEFORE (Battle Brothers: a man's small events gate at a median level 4).
bands.veteran: level 9 and up; LIFE, once in a life (Battle Brothers: the life stories at level 9 to 11).
bands.retold: 30 nights or more after a member's death, never within two nights of any death; one retelling per dead member, ever; never by the dead member's heir (Q144.X1).

wrong_detail._about: The analog horror law at the source: an ordinary story with one wrong detail, said plainly, never explained, never remarked on by anyone at the fire, never gore (QR-G line 26).
wrong_detail.share: at most one telling in five carries one; never two tellings in a row; never more than one per teller in a life; never in a retelling of the same dead member twice.

kinds.COUNT: a number from the company's own record, off by one (thirteen at the wash when the book has twelve).
kinds.NAME: a person in a story from before the dollar died carries the name of a member at the fire, at an age that cannot be them.
kinds.COMPANY: the company's own name inside a story from before the company existed.
kinds.THING: the thing is wrong in one plain way: warm, wet, newer than it can be.
kinds.DEAD: a dead member spoken of in the present tense, plainly ('told it to me again last night').
kinds.PLACE: the teller describes tonight's ground as it was before it fell, as if he saw it last week.

generator.once: A member tells at most one generated telling per band in a life (up to three). An heir is a new life and starts green (QR-AX rule 6). A dead member's telling is retold once. The 27 authored tellings on the shelf are bound to jobs and do not count against a member's three.
generator.bound_ratio: Over any act, a telling bound to a job (the shelf's 27) is at most one telling in three, and two bound tellings never fire in a row (the fire is not a job board).
generator.fragments_size: Battle Brothers' backstory shape (the developers' own forum post, quoted in the wiki dump's Developer Posts page): four groups of three or four options with %name% (Adventurous Noble: 4, 3, 4, 4). Ours: four groups of four per trade for BEFORE (16), and a coda bank of about 12 per band for line 3. The 12 starting trades: 192 fragments; all 77 trades: about 1,232.

fragments_example._about: Two trades written the Battle Brothers way, as the size and the voice PEOPLE's bank aims at. draft:true.

who: Eleven years in the gypsum at Blue Diamond
I drilled limestone at the Sloan quarry
I ran the night crew at the Apex pits
My people dug gold out of Eldorado Canyon
person: a kid from Pahrump who never talked
place_before: the canyon road to the river
moment: the week the pay cards stopped working
the day they locked the gate with us outside it
the morning the trucks did not come
the last shift, when nobody blew the whistle

who: Five in the morning in the hardware store lot
I cleaned rooms on the Strip by the day
I picked up drywall work off a corner on Lake Mead
I hung signs for whoever paid that week
person: Dona Chela with her coffee cart
a contractor who only ever said 'you, you, not you'
the security guard who let us use the hose
place_before: the lot by the cart corral
the service hall under the casino
the corner by the check-cashing place
moment: the week nobody came to the lot
the day the cards stopped paying
the night the Strip went dark for good
the morning the guard did not open the gate
